title: Apartment Splitting of the Residual Exact Sequence
body_html:
Apartment Splitting of the Residual Exact Sequence

Let \[ 0\to Y\to W\to X\to0 \] be the residual exact sequence in the main epipelagic setup. Appendix 1 constructs a splitting of the quotient \(P\to J\) and a \(J\)-module splitting \[ W\simeq Y\oplus X. \]
proof_html: Using the fractional jump decomposition, define \(X^{[\mu]}\) and \(X_\mu=X^{[\mu]}\cap B_\mu\) for the tensor-product lattice \(B=L\otimes L'\). The natural map \[ X_{-1/(2m)}/X_{-1/(2m)}p_K\to B_{-1/(2m)}/B_{1/(2m)} \] splits the quotient \(W\to X\). The group schemes \(Q,Q'\) built from the fractional pieces have special fibers identified with \(G_L/G_{L,0+}\) and \(G'_{L'}/G'_{L',0+}\), so \(Q\times Q'\to P\) gives a splitting of \(P\to J\). Equivariance of the fractional decomposition gives the \(J\)-module splitting.
